title: Your IQ Will Explode With These 3 Riddles
hook: How many of these can you get right?
script:
Your IQ will explode with these three impossible riddles. Only a true genius can solve them all. Get ready, your first challenge starts now!

What has to be broken before you can use it? You have five seconds.
Time's up! The answer is an egg. Did you crack it?

Next up: What is always in front of you but can’t be seen? Five seconds, go!
And the answer is… the future! Are you feeling smarter yet?

Last one: What is full of holes but still holds water? Your final five seconds begin now!
The solution? A sponge! If you got all three, you're officially a genius. If not, don't worry, your IQ will explode with these three impossible riddles next time!
comment: How many riddles did you solve correctly? Let me know!
